firewall.title: Firewall
firewall.reportHint: Shared detections and authorized bans. Expiry waits for every participating node; repeat hits may extend a node's deadline.
firewall.exemptionHint: Temporarily exempt any public IP from fleet blacklists. Normal firewall checks still apply. Proxy evidence is retained.
firewall.deliveryPending: Saved. Delivery to connected nodes is queued; offline nodes reconcile when they reconnect.
firewall.priceHint: Purchasing is enabled only when both price and exemption hours are greater than zero.
firewall.detectionHint: Detections report to the master. Only master commands authorize new blacklist entries.
firewall.loadFailed: Could not load the unban price. Please retry.
firewall.saveFailed: Could not save the exemption. Retry with the same request.
firewall.invalidIP: Enter an individual public IPv4 or IPv6 address.
firewall.conflict: This IP is already exempt, or the price has changed. Refresh before retrying.
firewall.adminHint: Exempt an IP or CIDR from fleet blacklists for the selected hours. Offline nodes apply it when they reconnect.
firewall.adminInvalidPrefix: Enter an IPv4/IPv6 address or CIDR.
firewall.adminInvalidHours: Enter a whole number from 1 to 8760 hours.
